Large language models such as ChatGPT come with filters to keep certain info from getting out. A new mathematical argument shows that systems like this can never be completely safe.             <p>The post <a href="https://www.quantamagazine.org/cryptographers-show-that-ai-protections-will-always-have-holes-20251210/">Cryptographers Show That AI Protections Will Always Have Holes</a> first appeared on <a href="https://www.quantamagazine.org">Quanta Magazine</a></p>
